title: Story premise EDU045: The Idiom Meets a Literal Painter
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (language/communication). Hook: Should we translate the picture or the meaning? Takeaway/theme: An idiom’s intended meaning may not survive word-for-word translation.
description: A translator wants to convey that a task is easy, but a literal painting of an idiom produces an irrelevant object. A meaning card bridges to plain language and, only after review, an appropriate target-language expression.
